vault.title: Subscription vault
vault.subtitle: Everything that leaves your account every month, and the ones that look like they are paid for nothing.
vault.monthlyNote: What the cards below add up to.
vault.annualNote: Twelve months at the same rate.
vault.savingNote: a year if the flagged ones are cancelled.
vault.savingClean: Nothing is flagged — your subscriptions look fine.
vault.moreFlagged: and {n} more on the list below.
vault.noteInUse: Paid for and used — the charge keeps coming round, so there is nothing to do about this one.
vault.noteIdle: Nothing has been charged in {days} days, yet {monthly} a month is still set to come out.
vault.noteIdlePaused: Nothing has been charged in {days} days and this entry is already paused — cancel it with the provider to stop the auto-renew.
vault.notePriceCreep: The same charge went from {from} at the start to {to} on your last one — {pct}% more.
vault.noteDuplicate: {other} is charged for the same thing, so cancelling this copy keeps {monthly} a month.
vault.noteDuplicateNoRule: {other} is charged for the same thing and no recurring entry tracks this copy — cancel it with the provider.
vault.noteOneOff: It repeats {charges} times a year but no recurring entry tracks it, so nothing is checking it for you.
vault.emptyBody: Nothing here charges you every month yet. Add a recurring entry for a streaming app, the gym or a phone plan and this screen fills itself in.
vault.cancelBody: "{name}" stops here and keeps about {amount} a month with you. The entries it already made stay in your list with their history.
vault.cancelKeeps: The payment itself stops with the company — cancelling here only stops the app from logging it.
vault.noRuleNote: No recurring entry behind this one — cancel it with the company.
vault.howIdle: Unused: nothing charged for {days} days, even though the payment is still set up.
vault.howCreep: Price creep: the same charge up by {pct}% or more between your first and your last one.
vault.howDuplicate: Duplicate: two live subscriptions in one category, within {pct}% of each other, with a word in common in their names.
vault.howOneOff: No rule behind it: a charge that repeats {count} times a year on a steady beat with no recurring entry watching it.
vault.committedNote: Your recurring entries alone commit {amount} a month, whether they are used or not.
